description: A multimodal GLM vision model with native Function Calling, supporting image, video, file, and text inputs. Optimized for multimodal Agent workflows with visual understanding and executable action capabilities.

i18n.en: A multimodal GLM vision model with native Function Calling, supporting image, video, file, and text inputs. Optimized for multimodal Agent workflows with visual understanding and executable action capabilities.
i18n.zh: 原生支持 Function Calling 的多模态 GLM 视觉模型，支持图片、视频、文件和文本输入。面向多模态 Agent 工作流优化，具备视觉理解与可执行行动能力。

description: A lightweight, high-performance GLM model with 106B total / 12B active parameters. Delivers strong reasoning and coding at low cost, optimized for high-throughput agent and chat applications.

i18n.en: A lightweight, high-performance GLM model with 106B total / 12B active parameters. Delivers strong reasoning and coding at low cost, optimized for high-throughput agent and chat applications.
i18n.zh: 轻量高性能 GLM 模型，1060 亿总参数 / 120 亿激活参数。以低成本提供强大的推理与编程能力，面向高吞吐 Agent 和对话应用优化。

description: A flagship open GLM model for systems design, coding, and long-horizon agents. The open foundation model targets complex systems design and production-grade programming across long-running agent workflows.

i18n.en: A flagship open GLM model for systems design, coding, and long-horizon agents. The open foundation model targets complex systems design and production-grade programming across long-running agent workflows.
i18n.zh: 面向系统设计、编程与长周期 Agent 的 GLM 旗舰开放模型。开放基础模型面向复杂系统设计，以及长周期 Agent 工作流中的生产级编程。

description: A fast GLM model optimized for real-world agent environments and efficient inference. It is deeply optimized for fast inference in real-world, tool-using agent environments.

i18n.en: A fast GLM model optimized for real-world agent environments and efficient inference. It is deeply optimized for fast inference in real-world, tool-using agent environments.
i18n.zh: 针对真实 Agent 环境与高效推理优化的高速 GLM 模型。针对真实世界中使用工具的 Agent 环境进行深度优化，强调快速推理。

description: A GLM model with stronger coding and sustained performance on long-horizon tasks. Its coding improvements focus on sustained, independent execution over tasks that extend far beyond short interactions.

i18n.en: A GLM model with stronger coding and sustained performance on long-horizon tasks. Its coding improvements focus on sustained, independent execution over tasks that extend far beyond short interactions.
i18n.zh: 强化编程能力与长周期任务持续执行表现的 GLM 模型。编程能力提升重点面向远超短时交互、需要持续独立执行的任务。

description: A long-context GLM reasoning model for project-level software engineering and agents. The large-scale reasoning model is intended for project-level software engineering and long-horizon agent workflows.

i18n.en: A long-context GLM reasoning model for project-level software engineering and agents. The large-scale reasoning model is intended for project-level software engineering and long-horizon agent workflows.
i18n.zh: 面向项目级软件工程与 Agent 的长上下文 GLM 推理模型。大规模推理模型面向项目级软件工程和长周期 Agent 工作流。
